name: Angel of Eternal Protection
tactics: The angel of eternal protection stays near its ward so it can use ward in undeath to keep its master alive. It gives anything to keep its ward alive, so it does not hesitate to use burning the black candle. When its ward is in mortal danger, the angel tries to avoid conditions that prevent it from using immediate actions.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description:
The heaviest type of armor, made up of shaped plates of metal or similarly resilient material, plate provides the most armor protection. The cost for its superior fortification is mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Plate armor grants +9 AC at levels 6-10, +10 AC at levels 11-15, +11 AC at levels 16-20, +12 AC at levels 21-25, and +14 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Angelic Shield
traits.details: while the angel is within 5 squares of its ward, each enemy treats the area within the aura as difficult terrain.

auras.name: Angelic Shield
auras.details: while the angel is within 5 squares of its ward, each enemy treats the area within the aura as difficult terrain.

hit.description: damage plus 10 necrotic and radiant damage

effect.description: the angel designates the target as its ward until it designates a new creature as its ward. While the angel is within 5 squares of its ward, the ward takes only half damage from melee and ranged attacks; the angel takes the other half of that damage. While the angel is adjacent to its ward, the ward gains a +2 bonus to AC. A creature can be the ward of only one angel at a time

powers.name: Burning the Black Candle
powers.trigger: when the angel of eternal protection’s ward drops to 0 hit points and is within 5 squares of the angel

effect.description: The angel of eternal protection’s ward regains 30 hit points and can teleport 10 squares (no action). The angel of eternal protection then dies.
Any attack against the angel of eternal protection takes a -2 penalty to the attack roll.
